trust_title: Free for every realtor. CRM included.
trust_sub: No plans, no subscriptions. Database, CRM, documents and chat — all in.
tr1_d: Database and CRM are free for every realtor and agency. No hidden fees.
tr2_d: Requests, deals, tasks and history in one place. Phones, e-mails and notes are encrypted.
tr3_d: Envelope encryption with AES-256-GCM: each agency has its own key, the master key is never stored in the database. 2FA login (Google Authenticator).
tr4_d: Contracts, receipts, handover acts and KVKK are filled from the CRM, exported to DOCX and PDF — ready to print.
crm_hint: Phones and e-mails are stored encrypted
app_note: The mobile app is for convenient work on the go: browsing, search, messaging. Full management — unit boards, users, settings — is on the website.

s2_d: We make sure you work in real estate.
s3_d: We connect you and help you settle in.

r.sub: A professional community: add your objects, find options from colleagues and deal directly. No public marketplaces, no intermediaries.
r.note: We guarantee confidentiality: objects are visible only to verified members.
r.spot_title: A client selection — in one link
r.spot_d: Mark apartments with the folder — and send the client a personal link. Inside: only the chosen options, your contacts and a contact button. The client always comes back to you.
r.spot_note: The more of us in the community — the more options for your clients. Invite colleagues.
r.a1: Practicing realtors and real-estate agencies. We review every request manually to make sure you actually work in the market — only then do we open access. No random people or buyers inside.
r.a2: Only verified community members. The base is not indexed by search engines, objects are not published anywhere and are invisible outside the system. You decide which objects to add.
r.a3: ONEPLAN is free: registration, the base, search and messaging cost nothing.
r.q4: How do I reach the listing realtor?
r.a4: Every card shows the realtor in charge of the object — message them directly in one click. No chains of three intermediaries: you agree between yourselves and split the commission two ways.
r.f1_d: A live catalog maintained by realtors themselves.
r.f2_d: Add an object — the whole community sees it right away.
r.f3_d: District, rooms, budget — an option in minutes.
r.f4_d: No intermediaries: the commission stays between you two.

d.sub: Unit board, prices, documents, construction diary and a public showcase. A full replacement for Google Drive — modern and convenient.
d.note: We guarantee it: your base is isolated, only the showcase you share goes outside.
d.spot_d: Share the object page with agencies and buyers: live prices, statuses and photos — no PDFs and price lists in chats.
d.spot_note: The link can be opened anytime — the data is always fresh.
d.q1: Will realtors or other companies see my base?
d.a1: No. Your base is fully isolated: neither realtors nor other developers can see it. The only thing that goes outside is the public showcase — an object page you choose who to share with.
d.a2: Contracts, layouts, permits, photos and the construction diary live in the system, attached to the object. No more digging through Google Drive folders and forwarding links in chats.
d.a3: ONEPLAN is free: all features are available at no cost.
d.a4: Usually one day is enough. Together we load your objects, set up the unit board, the team and permissions — and you start working right away.
d.f1_d: Statuses, prices and layouts — like on paper, but live.
d.f2_d: Contracts, photos and the construction diary in one place.
d.f3_d: An object page by link — always up to date.
d.f4_d: Team, permissions and hidden objects under control.

kvkk_p: 1. Data controller. This notice is provided under Article 10 of the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (“KVKK”) and the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles for Fulfilling the Obligation to Inform. The data controller is ONETEAM İNŞAAT LTD. ŞTİ. (the “Company”).

2. Personal data processed. The Company processes: identity data (name, surname), contact data (phone number, e-mail address), professional data (company/agency name, information on your real-estate activity), the content of the comment in the request form and, if you use the platform, account and transaction security records (session and log records).

3. Method of collection. Personal data is collected electronically, by fully or partly automated means: through the request form on the website, your actions on the platform and correspondence with you.

4. Purposes of processing. Your data is processed to: evaluate your access request and contact you; verify your application (confirmation of real-estate activity); create and manage your ONEPLAN account; send your sign-in password and account-recovery e-mails; operate, secure and improve the service; and fulfil obligations arising from legislation.

5. Legal grounds. Processing relies on KVKK Art. 5/2(a) — being expressly provided for by law; Art. 5/2(c) — necessity for the conclusion or performance of a contract; Art. 5/2(ç) — compliance with a legal obligation of the controller; Art. 5/2(f) — the Company’s legitimate interests, provided your fundamental rights and freedoms are not harmed; and otherwise on your explicit consent (Art. 5/1) given via the checkbox in the request form.

6. Transfers. Your data is never sold or shared with third parties for marketing. In line with KVKK Arts. 8 and 9, it may be transferred only to infrastructure providers (hosting, e-mail delivery) to the extent required for the service to operate, and to authorised public institutions and judicial authorities upon their lawful request.

7. Retention. Data is kept for the duration of your membership and the limitation periods set by legislation, after which it is deleted, destroyed or anonymised under KVKK Art. 7 — or earlier upon your request.

8. Your rights (KVKK Art. 11). You have the right to: learn whether your data is processed; request information about processing; learn the purpose and whether the data is used in line with it; know the third parties to whom it is transferred in Turkey or abroad; request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data; request deletion or destruction under Art. 7; request that corrections and deletions be notified to third parties; object to a result unfavourable to you produced exclusively by automated analysis; and claim compensation for damage caused by unlawful processing.

9. How to apply. You may submit requests concerning your rights in writing or via the Company’s contact channels, in accordance with the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles of Application to the Data Controller. Requests are resolved free of charge as soon as possible and within 30 (thirty) days at the latest.
priv_p: We respect your privacy. This policy describes what data the ONEPLAN platform collects and how we handle it.
Data collection. We only collect what you provide in the request form: name, company, phone, e-mail and comment. Your chosen interface language and view mode are also stored locally in your browser.
Use. The data is used solely to contact you, onboard you to the platform and support you. We do not send spam and do not share contacts with third parties.

Property database. Objects added by realtors are visible only to verified members of the closed community. A developer’s base is isolated: only the public showcase the developer chooses to share goes outside.
Security. Access to data is restricted by roles and permissions, connections are encrypted, and every access request is reviewed manually.
Deletion. You may request deletion of your account and related data at any time by contacting us.
Questions about this policy: ONETEAM İNŞAAT LTD. ŞTİ.
